ABOUT

YOUR WED STORIES

With Harsha
& Vijay Sawnani

The people behind the photographs.

A wedding holds many stories at once. There is the one you planned, and the one unfolding in the corners: a parent watching, friends finding each other, a quiet moment before everything begins.

We are Harsha Sawnani and Vijay Sawnani, the people behind Your Wed Stories. Through photographs and films, our studio follows the celebration and the connections that give it meaning.

Some photographs show you how it looked.
Others bring you back to being there.

There is space in our work for a carefully made portrait and a moment that cannot be directed. We pay attention to the setting, the light and the little gestures, while keeping the people at the centre of the story.

Tell us who is coming, which traditions matter to you, and what you want to remember. That is where we begin.
